items.title: 5.10 Application of Analytical Geometry to Real Life (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Book p. 161-162 (PDF 163-164): introduction, second 'Example 17' (planets, AU to km; shown as Example 18), Remember! box on the astronomical unit, Example 19 (aircraft)

blocks.title: Ustad ki baat
blocks.text: Bachon, ab tak humne lines, slopes, faasle aur angles ke formulas seekhe. Aksar students poochte hain: 'Sir, yeh sab asal zindagi mein kahan kaam aata hai?' Is section ka jawab hai: har jagah! Hawai jahaz ka raasta, planets ke darmiyan faasla, chhat (roof) ka jhukao, sab analytical geometry se nikalte hain. Aaj do misaalein dekhenge: ek astronomy (falkiyat) ki, aur ek aviation (hawabazi) ki. Dono mein bas wahi purane formulas lagenge: distance formula aur slope.

Analytical geometry mathematics ko asal zindagi se jorti hai. Is ki madad se hum positions (maqaam), faasle, slopes aur angles ka tajziya kar sakte hain, isi liye yeh aviation, astronomy, engineering aur science aur technology ke bohat se shobon mein lazmi hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Asal idea yeh hai: asal situation (airport ka naqsha, nizam-e-shamsi, ghar ki chhat) par ek coordinate grid bichha dijiye. Ab har jagah ek point \((x, y)\) ban jati hai, har seedha raasta ek line, aur is unit ke formulas (distance, slope, line ki equation, lines ke darmiyan angle) amli sawalon ke jawab de dete hain. Aik baat hamesha yaad rakhiye: coordinates jis unit mein hon (km, AU), jawab bhi usi unit mein aata hai; agar sawal doosri unit maange to aakhir mein badalna hai.

blocks.title: Numbering note (ours)
blocks.text: Kitab mein 'Example 17' ka label do dafa chhapa hai: ek 5.9 mein aur doosra yahan, aur Example 18 kahin nahi. Hum ne is doosre ko Example 18 likha hai taa ke har misaal ka apna number ho aur aap ko dhoka na ho; agli misaal apna chhapa hua number 19 hi rakhti hai.

blocks.title: Example 18
blocks.problem: Planet \(A\) is at \((1, 0)\) \(AU\) and planet \(B\) is at \((-0.5, 0.866)\) \(AU\). Find the distance between them. Write answer in km.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(A(1, 0)\) aur \(B(-0.5, 0.866)\); coordinates astronomical units (AU) mein hain.
Maloom karna: \(A\) aur \(B\) ka faasla km mein.
Tareeqa: do points ka faasla distance formula \(d = \sqrt{(x_{2} - x_{1})^{2} + (y_{2} - y_{1})^{2}}\) se nikalta hai. Yeh formula asal mein Pythagoras theorem hai: \(x\) ka farq aur \(y\) ka farq right triangle ki do sides hain aur faasla us ka hypotenuse. Jawab pehle AU mein aayega, phir km mein badlenge.

Distance formula mein values rakhein
\[AB = \sqrt{[1 - (-0.5)]^{2} + (0 - 0.866)^{2}}\]
Kyun: \(x_{1} = 1, y_{1} = 0\) aur \(x_{2} = -0.5, y_{2} = 0.866\). Kaun pehle minus ho, is se farq nahi parta, kyunke har farq ka square ho jata hai aur square kabhi negative nahi.

Farq ke squares
\[1 - (-0.5) = 1.5,\quad 1.5^{2} = 2.25\]
\[(-0.866)^{2} = 0.749956 \approx 0.75\]
Kyun: negative ko minus karna jama karne ke barabar hai, is liye \(1 + 0.5 = 1.5\). Aur \(0.866\) asal mein \(\sqrt{3}/2\) ki round ki hui value hai, jis ka square bilkul \(0.75\) hai.
Dhyan dein: \(1 - (-0.5)\) ko \(0.5\) likhna sab se aam ghalti hai.

Square root lein
\[AB = \sqrt{2.25 + 0.75} = \sqrt{3} = 1.732 \text{ AU}\]
Kyun: \(2.25 + 0.75 = 3\), aur \(\sqrt{3} \approx 1.732\).

Km mein badlein
\[1 \text{ AU} \approx 149.6 \text{ million km}\]
\[AB = 1.732 \times 149.6 = 259.1 \text{ million km}\]
Kyun: Remember! box ke mutabiq 1 AU \(= 149597870700\) m \(= 149597870.7\) km, yani taqreeban 149.6 million km. Jitne AU hon, utni dafa 149.6 million km; is liye multiply kiya.

Tasdeeq:
\[OA = 1,\quad OB = \sqrt{0.25 + 0.75} = 1\]
Kyun: dono planets origin (Sooraj) se 1 AU door hain aur un ke darmiyan \(120^{\circ}\) ka angle hai, to \(AB = 2\sin 60^{\circ} = \sqrt{3}\) AU. Doosre raste se bhi wahi jawab \(\checkmark\).

blocks.title: Remember!
blocks.text: Astronomical unit \((AU)\) lambai (length) ki ek unit hai aur bilkul 149597870700 m ke barabar hai. Yeh taqreeban Zameen aur Sooraj ka ausat faasla hai, is liye planets ke faasle naapne ke liye bohat aasan unit hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Agar ek planet \((0, 1)\) AU par aur doosra \((0, -1)\) AU par ho to faasla kitne million km hoga?
Jawab: faasla \(2\) AU, yani \(2 \times 149.6 = 299.2\) million km.

blocks.title: Example 19
blocks.problem: Aircraft flies from \(A(100, 200)\) km to \(B(500, 800)\) km. Find slope of the track and straight line distance.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(A(100, 200)\) aur \(B(500, 800)\), km mein.
Maloom karna: raaste (track) \(AB\) ka slope aur seedha (straight line) faasla.
Tareeqa: slope ke liye \(m = \dfrac{y_{2} - y_{1}}{x_{2} - x_{1}}\) aur faasle ke liye distance formula. Dono formulas wahi hain jo hum straight line ke chapter mein bar bar istemal kar chuke hain; yahan bas un ka asal zindagi mein kaam dekh rahe hain.

Track ka slope
\[m = \dfrac{800 - 200}{500 - 100} = \dfrac{600}{400} = 1.5\]
Kyun: slope = 'rise over run', yani \(y\) mein tabdeeli ko \(x\) mein tabdeeli se divide karna. Jahaz \(x\)-direction mein 400 km aur \(y\)-direction mein 600 km chala.

Distance formula
\[AB = \sqrt{(500 - 100)^{2} + (800 - 200)^{2}}\]
\[= \sqrt{400^{2} + 600^{2}}\]
Kyun: 400 aur 600 ek right triangle ki do sides hain aur jahaz ka seedha raasta us ka hypotenuse; Pythagoras theorem.

Hisaab mukammal karein
\[= \sqrt{160000 + 360000} = \sqrt{520000}\]
\[= 721.11 \text{ km}\]
Kyun: \(400^{2} = 160000\) aur \(600^{2} = 360000\); jama 520000 aur us ka square root calculator se 721.11.

Tasdeeq:
\[721.11^{2} \approx 520000 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: jawab ka square wapas 520000 de raha hai. Slope 1.5 ka matlab hai ke \(x\)-direction mein har 1 km par jahaz \(y\)-direction mein 1.5 km chalta hai; track ka angle \(\tan^{-1}1.5 \approx 56.3^{\circ}\) hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Ek drone \(P(0, 0)\) m se \(Q(30, 40)\) m tak seedha urta hai. Slope aur faasla?
\[m = \dfrac{40 - 0}{30 - 0} = \dfrac{4}{3}\]
\[PQ = \sqrt{30^{2} + 40^{2}} = \sqrt{2500} = 50 \text{ m}\]
Mashhoor 3-4-5 wala triangle, bas 10 guna bada. Aise aasaan numbers se formula ki mashq kar lijiye, phir mushkil numbers bhi asaan lagenge.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \((x_{1}, y_{1})\) aur \((x_{2}, y_{2})\) ka faasla: \(\sqrt{(x_{2} - x_{1})^{2} + (y_{2} - y_{1})^{2}}\), coordinates wali unit mein.
2. Slope \(= \dfrac{y_{2} - y_{1}}{x_{2} - x_{1}}\); raaste ka angle slope ka \(\tan^{-1}\) hai.
3. 1 AU \(= 149597870700\) m \(\approx 149.6\) million km.
4. Kitab ka doosra 'Example 17' hum ne Example 18 likha hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Unit badalna bhool jana: sawal km maange to \(1.732\) AU jawab nahi.
2. \(1 - (-0.5) = 0.5\) likh dena; negative ko minus karna jama karna hai, sahi jawab \(1.5\).
3. Slope mein upar \(x\) ka farq aur neeche \(y\) ka farq likh dena; upar hamesha \(y\).
